election.voteByMail: Request a vote-by-mail package by October 18, 2026 (online at elections.bc.ca/votebymail or by phone at 1-800-661-8683). Completed packages must be received by Elections BC by 8 p.m. Pacific time on October 24, 2026; a postmark is not enough.
election.howToVote: Eligible voters can vote at any advance voting place from October 16 to 21, at a voting place on October 24, or by mail. Voters who are not registered can register when they vote by showing identification with their name and current address. Check Elections BC for voting locations and accepted ID.
